title: add rag agent quickstarts, tool-calling examples, and docs site updates
author: Priya Kapoor
release_notes: Add RAG agent quickstarts and tool-calling examples; docs site updated with new sidebar entries and step-by-step guides.
description: Motivation: ship beginner-friendly RAG agent quickstarts and tool-calling examples to help users adopt agents with Redwood's runtime. This PR adds templates, example playbooks, TypeScript and Python quickstarts, and updates the docs site sidebar + step-by-step guides so the content is discoverable. Changes are focused on docs and examples only; no runtime code changes. Checklist: - [x] Add RAG templates and Example agents (TS + Python) - [x] Add tool-calling examples (HTTP mock tool + calendar tool) - [x] Update docs site pages and sidebar entries - [x] Add CI checks for redwood-examples examples (lint + unit smoke tests) - [x] Include short playbook demonstrating canary + fallback model routing Notes: kept examples small and self-contained; playbooks reference the hosted API helper utilities. Testing: ran docs site build locally, ran examples CI workflow (mocked HTTP tool), smoke-tested quickstarts against local dev server and verified expected responses. CI had one flaky lint job that was re-run; final status is green.
